symptom: The release verifier kept retrying although Hugging Face Dataset Viewer exposed both healthy splits.
root_cause: The verifier expected a num_examples field from the official /splits endpoint. That endpoint lists dataset, config, and split identifiers only; row counts belong to the /size endpoint as num_rows.
resolution: Validate availability with /splits, obtain non-zero per-split row counts from /size, and validate the canonical schema with /first-rows.
